description: This is a shell script designed for testing the 'git merge-tree' command, including various test cases for merging files, directories (trees), and conflict scenarios. It sets up different git repositories and commits to verify the behavior of merge-tree under various conditions.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs the enclosed commands, compares output against expected results.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the contents of two files or strings for equality.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Checks that the given output or file is empty, indicating no differences.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers commands to run after the test for cleanup purposes.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with the specified message, filename, and content.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the internal clock or timestamp used by the test framework to simulate time passing.

methods.name: test_write_lines
methods.description: Writes specified lines to a file or stream, used for preparing expected outputs.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
